faqs.q: What is the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose used for?
faqs.a: The Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose is a TPU lay flat hose for diesel, fuel and oil transfer, in sizes 2" to 12", with a copper earthing wire woven into the jacket for static dissipation. It serves refuelling of drilling rigs and camps and temporary fuel lines between storage and equipment.

faqs.q: How do I order the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose, since there is no size table?
faqs.a: There is no per-size table for this line: tell us the fuel, flow, bore and pump pressure and we confirm the rating before quoting. Bores run 2" to 12", in dark green or light green.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose come in?
faqs.a: Bores run from 2 in to 12 in, supplied in continuous lengths up to 400 m or as made-up assemblies with couplings. Pick the bore from the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept; see [our lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart).

faqs.q: Is the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose antistatic?
faqs.a: Yes. A copper wire woven into the jacket gives electrical continuity along the hose, so static from the flow can be earthed through conductive couplings at both ends. Check end-to-end continuity before each use; [our antistatic fuel transfer hose guide](/blog/antistatic-fuel-transfer-hose-guide) explains the routine.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose have?
faqs.a: A per-size pressure table is not published for this line. Max working pressure is confirmed with the quotation: tell us the fuel, bore and pump pressure and we confirm it before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose made from?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are oil-resistant TPU, extruded through a circular-woven polyester jacket with a copper earthing wire, rated -50 °C to +80 °C (-60 °F to +176 °F). The cover resists fuels, oils, chemicals, UV and ozone.

faqs.q: Which fuels can the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose carry?
faqs.a: It is built for diesel, fuel and oil transfer; send the fluid, temperature and any additives and we confirm compatibility. [Our TPU versus NBR versus PVC lay flat hose guide](/blog/tpu-vs-nbr-vs-pvc-lay-flat-hose) compares the lining materials.

faqs.q: Can the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose be supplied with couplings fitted?
faqs.a: Yes, the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose can be made up as an assembly. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify, such as Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends, secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Send the length and both end connections through [our contact page](/contact); couplings are also listed under [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings), and [lay flat hose reels and winders](/c/lay-flat-hose-reels-winders) cover storage and deployment. Use conductive couplings so the earthing wire stays continuous.

faqs.q: How should the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose be laid and stored?
faqs.a: Unroll the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising, because a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst. After use, drain it, roll it flat from the far end, and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects.

faqs.q: How does the Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose compare with NBR lay flat hose?
faqs.a: This TPU hose carries a copper earthing wire for static dissipation and stays flexible from -50 °C to +80 °C, while the [NBR lay flat hoses](/c/nbr-lay-flat-hoses) are a separate range of rubber-lined lay flat hoses. [Our comparison guide](/blog/tpu-vs-nbr-vs-pvc-lay-flat-hose) sets out the differences.

faqs.a: Yes, Antistatic TPU Lay Flat Oil and Fuel Transfer Hose goes out of Dubai, UAE to export customers worldwide. Continuous lengths up to 400 m are made to order, and 200 m and 400 m coils are the usual supply. Tell us the destination port or country on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the shipping route with the price.

faqs.q: What is the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose used for?
faqs.a: The Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose is the reinforced version of our TPU well riser hose, for wells that run continuously, carry heavy pumps or see abrasive water, in sizes 1-1/4" to 12". A heavier jacket gives more tensile strength and a tougher cover.

faqs.q: How do I order the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose, since there is no size table?
faqs.a: There is no per-size table for this class: send the bore, pump model, setting depth and shut-off head and we confirm the rating against your duty before quoting. Bores run 1-1/4" to 12".

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose come in?
faqs.a: Bores run from 1-1/4 in to 12 in, supplied in continuous lengths up to 400 m. Pick the bore from the pump flow and friction loss; [our lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart) helps.

faqs.q: How does the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose differ from the standard TPU riser hose?
faqs.a: It has a reinforced jacket, giving higher tensile strength and abrasion resistance for heavy pumps, continuous duty and sandy water. The tube and cover materials are the same as the [TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose](/p/tpu-lay-flat-well-riser-hose).

faqs.q: What pressure and tensile rating does the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose have?
faqs.a: A per-size pressure and tensile table is not published for this heavy-duty class. Max working pressure is confirmed with the quotation, so send the bore, pump model, setting depth and shut-off head.

faqs.q: What is the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose made from?
faqs.a: The tube and cover are TPU, extruded through a reinforced circular-woven polyester jacket in one pass, rated -50 °C to +80 °C (-60 °F to +176 °F). It is black with a blue identification stripe, or blue.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose?
faqs.a: The listing gives no product standard and no per-size table. Ask on the RFQ for the documents your project needs and we confirm what can be supplied.

faqs.q: What couplings does the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose use?
faqs.a: Riser hose is joined to the pump and well head with dedicated couplings that carry the tensile load; see [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings). We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify, such as Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends, secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose.

faqs.q: How should the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose be installed?
faqs.a: Unroll it fully and lay it straight before pressurising, and raise and lower pressure gradually. [Our well riser hose installation guide](/blog/well-riser-hose-installation) covers handling and [our flexible riser versus steel column pipe guide](/blog/flexible-borehole-riser-vs-steel-column-pipe) compares the options.

faqs.q: When should I choose the Heavy-Duty TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose over standard riser hose?
faqs.a: Choose it for deep boreholes with heavy multistage submersible pumps, continuous dewatering and water-supply wells, or sandy and abrasive groundwater that wears a standard cover. For lighter duty see the [TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose](/p/tpu-lay-flat-well-riser-hose).

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose used for?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose is a red lay flat air line for compressors feeding rock drills, breakers, pneumatic pumps and other air tools on mine and construction sites. Because it rolls flat it is quicker to run out, recover and store than rigid air pipe or round rubber hose.

faqs.q: How do I order the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose, since there is no size table?
faqs.a: There is no per-size table: send the bore, length, compressor pressure and the end connections and we confirm the rating before quoting. The inner diameter range is on request.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose come in?
faqs.a: The inner diameter range is on request: tell us the flow and the tool or manifold it feeds. Pick the bore for the flow and the friction loss you can accept; [our compressed air lay flat hose guide](/blog/compressed-air-lay-flat-hose) explains sizing.

faqs.q: Do I need whip checks on the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose?
faqs.a: Yes. Any compressed-air hose can whip violently if a coupling lets go, so fit safety clips on claw couplings and whip-check cables across joints. Compressed air stores energy, so use couplings with safety clips across every joint.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose have?
faqs.a: A per-size pressure table is not published for this hose. Max working pressure is confirmed with the quotation, so send the bore and compressor pressure.

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose made from?
faqs.a: The tube is rubber / TPU over a circular-woven polyester jacket, with a TPU cover resistant to abrasion, oil and weather, in red. The listing gives no temperature range.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose?
faqs.a: The listing gives no product standard. Ask on the RFQ for any document your site needs, and see [our compressed air guide](/blog/compressed-air-lay-flat-hose) for use on mining and construction sites.

faqs.q: Can the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose be supplied with couplings fitted?

Send the length and both end connections through [our contact page](/contact); couplings are also listed under [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings), and [lay flat hose reels and winders](/c/lay-flat-hose-reels-winders) cover storage and deployment. Specify safety clips or whip checks for air service.

faqs.q: How should the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose be laid and stored?
faqs.a: Unroll the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising, because a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst. After use, drain it, roll it flat from the far end, and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects.

faqs.q: How does the TPU Lay Flat Compressed Air Hose compare with rigid air pipe or round rubber hose?
faqs.a: Because it rolls flat it is quicker to run out, recover and store than rigid air pipe or round rubber hose, and the TPU cover stands up to abrasion, oil and weather. Compressor-to-manifold air mains on mining and quarry benches are typical uses.

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose used for?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose is a light, flexible lay flat TPU hose for concrete and cement placement, in two pressure classes: standard to 50 bar and high-pressure to 85 bar, in sizes 3" to 5". The heavy circular-woven polyester jacket carries the load.

faqs.q: How are the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose part numbers such as IH-LF-TCPH-090L read?
faqs.a: IH-LF-TCP-125 is the 5 in standard class hose, IH-LF-TCPH-090 is the 3-1/2 in high-pressure class, and IH-LF-TCPH-090L is the light-wall version of the 3-1/2 in high-pressure hose. The H marks the high-pressure class and L marks the light wall.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose come in?
faqs.a: There are 8 rows from 3 in (inside diameter 76 mm) to 5 in (125 mm), in the standard and high-pressure classes, with weights of 1.40 to 3.30 kg per metre. The 3-1/2 in size has a light-wall option at 1.74 kg per metre.

faqs.q: Which pressure class of the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose do I need?
faqs.a: Use the high-pressure class (75 to 85 bar) when the concrete pump's maximum line pressure exceeds the standard class, typically on long horizontal or high vertical runs. Send the pump model and line layout on the RFQ; [our concrete placement hose guide](/blog/concrete-placement-hose-guide) explains the choice.

faqs.q: What working and burst pressure does the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose have?
faqs.a: Working pressure is Standard class 50 bar (5"); high-pressure class 75 to 85 bar: 50 bar on the 5 in standard class and 75 to 85 bar on the high-pressure class, with burst pressure 100 to 170 bar by size and class by size and class. The working pressure of the 3 in and 4 in standard class is confirmed with the quotation; burst is 126 bar on both.

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose made from?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose has a TPU tube and cover over a heavy circular-woven polyester jacket, rated -50 °C to +80 °C (-60 °F to +176 °F), in red or green. Tensile strength runs from 18,700 to 62,000 kg by size.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose?
faqs.a: The listing gives no product standard; it states working pressure, burst pressure and tensile strength by size. Ask on the RFQ for documents your project needs; [our pressure rating guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-pressure-ratings) explains the terms.

faqs.q: Can the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose be supplied with couplings fitted?
faqs.a: Yes, the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose can be made up as an assembly. We cut to length and fit the couplings you specify, such as Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged ends, secured with bands or expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose. Send the length and both end connections through [our contact page](/contact); couplings are also listed under [lay flat hose couplings](/c/lay-flat-hose-couplings), and [lay flat hose reels and winders](/c/lay-flat-hose-reels-winders) cover storage and deployment.

faqs.q: How should the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose be laid and cleaned after pumping?
faqs.a: Lay it straight before pressurising, flush out the concrete after use, and roll it flat from the far end to push out what is left. Store it out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects.

faqs.q: How does the standard class of the TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose compare with the high-pressure class?
faqs.a: The standard class is rated to 50 bar on the 5 in size (burst 100 bar), while the high-pressure class is rated 75 to 85 bar with burst 150 to 170 bar. The high-pressure class also adds the 3-1/2 in size and a light-wall option.

faqs.a: Yes, TPU Lay Flat Concrete Placement Hose goes out of Dubai, UAE to export customers worldwide. Continuous lengths up to 400 m are made to order, and 200 m and 400 m coils are the usual supply. Tell us the destination port or country on [our contact page](/contact) and we quote the shipping route with the price.

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose used for?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose is a large-bore lay flat TPU hose for mine dewatering, frac water and long temporary pipelines, in sizes 1-1/2" to 16" (larger to order) with working pressure 10 to 21 bar by size. It is also used to move frac water between storage ponds, tanks and well pads.

faqs.q: How are the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose part numbers such as IH-LF-TDW-040 organised?
faqs.a: The suffix is the nominal bore in millimetres: IH-LF-TDW-040 is the 1-1/2" hose, IH-LF-TDW-150 the 6" and IH-LF-TDW-400 the 16". Each row gives wall, inside diameter, tensile strength, burst pressure and weight per metre.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose come in?
faqs.a: The table has 11 sizes from 1-1/2" (inside diameter 39 +1.5 mm) to 16" (405 +3.0 mm), with larger bores to order. Weight runs 0.45 to 6.2 kg per metre.

faqs.q: How do I choose the bore of the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose?
faqs.a: Pick the bore for the flow you need and the friction loss you can accept over the line length, then check that its working pressure covers the pump's maximum plus surge. See [our lay flat hose size chart](/blog/lay-flat-hose-size-chart); for high-flow runs of 10 to 16 in, check the working pressure of the bore against the transfer pump.

faqs.q: What working and burst pressure does the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose have?
faqs.a: Working pressure is 10 to 21 bar by size and minimum burst pressure 30 to 63 bar by size: for example 1-1/2" is rated 21 bar working with 63 bar burst, and 16" is 10 bar with 30 bar. [Our lay flat hose pressure rating guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-pressure-ratings) explains the terms.

faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose made from?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose has a TPU tube and cover with a circular-woven high-tenacity polyester jacket, rated -50 °C to +80 °C (-60 °F to +176 °F). TPU has high abrasion resistance, and the cover is extruded through the jacket so it tolerates dragging better than PVC or rubber-lined layflat.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose?
faqs.a: The listing gives no product standard for the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose; it states the working pressure, burst pressure and tensile strength for each size. Ask on the RFQ for documents your project needs, and see [our dewatering discharge permits guide](/blog/dewatering-discharge-permits-dubai-qatar) for site rules.

faqs.a: Unroll the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising, because a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst. After use, drain it, roll it flat from the far end, and store the coil out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects. See [our guide to why lay flat hose fails](/blog/why-lay-flat-hose-fails).

faqs.q: Lay flat or suction hose: how does the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose compare?
faqs.a: Lay flat hose collapses under vacuum, so use the TPU Lay Flat Dewatering and Water Transfer Hose on the discharge side and put a rigid-helix hose such as the [EPDM/PE Suction Hose with Rigid Helix](/p/epdm-pe-suction-hose) on the pump intake; the [suction hoses](/c/suction-hoses) lists the range. faqs.q: What is the TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose used for?
faqs.a: The TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose is a heavy-wall lay flat hose pulled behind the tractor in slurry umbilical systems, in sizes 2-1/2" to 8" and kink-, abrasion- and hydrolysis-resistant.

faqs.q: How are the TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose part numbers such as IH-LF-TSD-065 organised?

faqs.q: Which sizes does the TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose come in?
faqs.a: The table has 9 sizes from 2-1/2" (inside diameter 65 mm) to 8" (204 mm), weighing 0.59 to 4.58 kg per metre, with tensile strength from 8300 to 53700 kg.

faqs.q: Which bore should I choose for the TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose?
faqs.a: Match the applicator's inlet and the flow you need: 4 to 6 in is common on umbilical systems, and larger bores reduce pressure loss on long drags. See [our slurry drag hose sizing and life guide](/blog/slurry-drag-hose-sizing-and-life).

faqs.q: What working and burst pressure does the TPU Lay Flat Slurry Drag Hose have?
